claims.claim: The client Harborlight Retail continues planning around an initial delivery target of 2026-11-01, but the latest QA forecast completion date is 2026-11-11, creating a direct schedule conflict.

claims.claim: Recorded delivery risks confirm that the QA forecast of 2026-11-11 does not support the 2026-11-01 target, security sign-off is pending, and no mitigation has been approved as a new launch commitment.

Mitigation: customer conversation, updated plan, and controlled pilot assessment. No mitigation has been approved as a new launch commitment.

claims.claim: As a conditional next step, Avery Tan must resolve the open leadership escalation (D-HBR-002), complete the required security and QA sign-offs, and obtain written customer agreement for any revised date or pilot before making a commitment.

evidence.excerpt: Avery Tan explained that a revised commitment requires written approval and a customer update. The client has not yet accepted a new date or a reduced-scope pilot.

response.answer:
The client Harborlight Retail continues planning around an initial delivery target of 2026-11-01, but the latest QA forecast completion date is 2026-11-11, creating a direct schedule conflict.

Production launch criteria are not met because QA sign-off has not been issued and security approval remains pending Darren Ng's review.

The delivery schedule conflict has been escalated to leadership under D-HBR-002, but it remains open with no authorized full-release extension or approved pilot.

A proposed reduced-scope pilot around 2026-11-01 and delayed production release to 2026-11-11 exists only as a draft change request and has not been approved.

Recorded delivery risks confirm that the QA forecast of 2026-11-11 does not support the 2026-11-01 target, security sign-off is pending, and no mitigation has been approved as a new launch commitment.

As a conditional next step, Avery Tan must resolve the open leadership escalation (D-HBR-002), complete the required security and QA sign-offs, and obtain written customer agreement for any revised date or pilot before making a commitment.
